target.statement: CoR-Math-7B achieves 66.7% zero-shot Pass@1 on the MATH benchmark.

compute.basis: Reproducing the target requires training a 7B model on a 167k multi-paradigm dataset, which involves generating Lean proofs and Python code, and then evaluating on MATH; this is a multi-day effort on a single GPU and likely infeasible on a laptop.

blockers: No code or model weights released
Training requires significant GPU resources (e.g., 80GB VRAM)
Dataset construction requires proprietary LLM APIs (GPT-4o) and Lean prover
Evaluation requires running a 7B model on 5000 MATH problems
title: Chain-of-Reasoning: Towards Unified Mathematical Reasoning in Large Language Models via a Multi-Paradigm Perspective
